featuredReviews.author: Larkin Dent
featuredReviews.text: Cyntya and her team do excellent work, and are super efficient as well. They were polite, professional and up front about what is included in a standard vs. deep cleaning. Sun Ray charges a very reasonable price considering the quality and efficiency of their work, plus they bring all their own cleaning supplies and tools (vacuum, etc.). I would recommend this crew to anyone needing help cleaning their home!

featuredReviews.author: Robyn Bergesen
featuredReviews.text: Cyntya and her team are fantastic. She is our trusted eyes on the ground for our remotely managed rental property. Always thorough, helpful, and very pleasant to work with! We constantly get notes in Airbnb reviews about how clean the property is. They're the best!

featuredReviews.author: scott nomfret
featuredReviews.text: Terrific cleaning job that left the unit smelling and looking like it was brand new. But what really made the experience especially terrific was the unparalleled communication and flexibility working with my schedule. Bonus points for the friendliness and reasonable rates. I'd absolutely use Sun-Ray again! Highly recommended.

featuredReviews.author: Sharron Error
featuredReviews.text: SunRay is absolutely awesome to work with. Excellent work every time. Makes corrections if any issues are encountered immediately. Always willing to go the extra mile if asked. I have enjoyed working with Cyntya!

featuredReviews.author: Glenn Herwig
featuredReviews.text: Cyntya and Raquel were fabulous at cleaning our entire home. They are the best home cleaners in all of SLC! Don't hesitate to reach out to them.

featuredReviews.author: Neil McKenna
featuredReviews.text: We hired Sun Ray from the east coast coming into town and it was a pleasure dealing with them. Excellent, clear communication which is very appreciated and terrific price for a job well done!

featuredReviews.author: Rachael Letendre
featuredReviews.text: Great price. We have used Sun Ray Cleaning services twice now and LOVE how clean and fresh our home feels after! They do such an amazing job— thank you Cyntia, Steve, and Raquel!

featuredReviews.author: Jill Moorcroft
featuredReviews.text: Amazingly thorough cleaning! Great communication! Always trying to please and make things easy!

featuredReviews.author: Andrew Harrington
featuredReviews.text: Highly recommend! They did a great job at our home.

featuredReviews.author: Rachel Dzurilla
featuredReviews.text: Excellent cleaning. The house was very welled cleaned. Highly recommend.
